title: Simplify durable project roles
objective: Replace the task- and subsystem-specific instructions embedded in the durable project test-agent record with one concise stable capability definition, while preserving ownership, evidence-classification, scientific-integrity, and human-authority boundaries.
authorized_scope: The simplified role retains stable project test-evidence capability, explicit task and path ownership, independent contract testing and oracles, VVUQ distinctions, scientific and human-authority limits, stop conditions, and concise handoff duties. Detailed test mechanics remain owned by `develop-python-test-evidence`; task-specific paths remain owned by assignments.

Other project agents, durable harness agents, historical agents, skills, harness behavior, tests, scientific source, dependencies, retained evidence, live discovery, retirement, delegation expansion, SQLite, evidence-subsystem work, and maintained command-interface work remain unchanged and unauthorized.

Completion required ownership validation, writer handoffs, one read-only integration review, one bounded deterministic documentation correction, focused validation, and synchronized documentation. The `ksdft2effmass-tests` role is now a concise stable capability record; the review found no material agent, VVUQ, skill-routing, authority, or ownership defect after correction. Successors remain inactive, and no task completion activates another stage.
